title: Sandy Terraces Nudist Campground

services.name: Sandy Terraces Rentals
services.desc: Sandy Terraces has Tenting & RV Campsites, a handicap accessible rest room adjacent to our heated pool, a septic dumping station, wifi internet service, ice and a Keurig coffee bar available for your convenience. All sites include electric and water hookups. Due to power limitations (30 amp service) air conditioning use is prohibited in the camp. PLEASE NOTE, WE DO NOT PROVIDE BEDDING (INCLUDING PILLOWS, SHEETS, BLANKETS) OR TOWELS, CAMPERS MUST BRING THEIR OWN. ALL BEDS ARE QUEEN-SIZE. Blended in the lush forest surroundings, Nature is experienced at its Best!
